name: Voxel Chunk Management
definition: Manages a 3D block of voxel data, tracking dirty flags for terrain/object meshing, neighbor references, and block handlers. Triggers remeshing when voxel properties change.
summary: Voxel Chunk Management handles storage and state tracking for fixed-size 3D voxel blocks, isolating boundary updates to prevent cascading recomputations across the sparse voxel grid.
